subject: sounds
title: Word Families
about: Words that share an ending chunk belong to one family: cat, hat and bat are the -at family and bug, rug and hug are the -ug family (this level uses -at, -an, -ig, -op, -ug, -ell and -ump). Hearing the shared chunk is NC RF.1.3 (phonological awareness), and reading a new word by its family is the fast route to NC RF.1.4.b, decoding regularly spelled one-syllable words.
tip: Say the chunk on its own first (at, at, at), then try each choice and ask: does it end with that chunk?

cards.q: Which word is in the -at family?
cards.sayQ: Which word is in the at family? at, like hat.
cards.note: cat ends with at: c-at. It is in the -at family with hat and bat.

cards.q: Cat, hat, bat. What family are they in?
cards.note: cat, hat, bat all end with at. That makes them the -at family.

cards.q: Hat, sat, pat. Which word is in their family?
cards.note: hat, sat, pat end with at. mat ends with at too, so it is in the -at family.

cards.q: Which word is in the -an family?
cards.sayQ: Which word is in the an family? an, like pan.
cards.note: man ends with an: m-an. It is in the -an family with pan and fan.

cards.q: Fan, can, van. What family are they in?
cards.note: fan, can, van all end with an. That makes them the -an family.

cards.q: Which word is in the -ig family?
cards.sayQ: Which word is in the ig family? ig, like big.
cards.note: pig ends with ig: p-ig. It is in the -ig family with big and wig.

cards.q: Which word rhymes with big and ends in -ig?
cards.sayQ: Which word rhymes with big and ends in ig?
cards.note: big, dig. Both end with ig, so they rhyme and share the -ig family.

cards.q: Hop, mop, top. What family are they in?
cards.note: hop, mop, top all end with op. That makes them the -op family.

cards.q: Which word rhymes with stop and ends in -op?
cards.sayQ: Which word rhymes with stop and ends in op?
cards.note: stop, shop. Both end with op, so they rhyme and share the -op family.

cards.q: Which word is in the -ug family?
cards.sayQ: Which word is in the ug family? ug, like bug.
cards.note: hug ends with ug: h-ug. It is in the -ug family with bug and rug.

cards.q: Bug, rug, jug. What family are they in?
cards.note: bug, rug, jug all end with ug. That makes them the -ug family.

cards.q: Bell, well, fell. What family are they in?
cards.note: bell, well, fell all end with ell. That makes them the -ell family.

cards.q: Sell, tell, yell. Which word is in their family?
cards.note: sell, tell, yell end with ell. shell ends with ell too, so it is in the -ell family.

cards.q: Which word rhymes with jump and ends in -ump?
cards.sayQ: Which word rhymes with jump and ends in ump?
cards.note: jump, bump. Both end with ump, so they rhyme and share the -ump family.

cards.q: Which word is in the -ump family?
cards.sayQ: Which word is in the ump family? ump, like jump.
cards.note: dump ends with ump: d-ump. It is in the -ump family with jump and bump. A dump truck dumps its load.

cards.q: Jump, bump, lump. Which word is in their family?
cards.note: jump, bump, lump end with ump. pump ends with ump too, so it is in the -ump family.
